Hiring process

Three conversations. No tests.

We hire on alignment with our values and capacity to do the work — not on how well you perform under exam conditions.

1
STEP 01

Apply

Send us a CV and a short note about why this role matters to you. Jordan reads everything and replies within five business days.

2
STEP 02

Conversation

One conversation with the hiring manager and one of our team — about 45 minutes. We talk about the work, your values, and how you'd fit at the table.

3
STEP 03

Reference & offer

We check two references and come back to you within a week. Salary, conditions, and start date all on the table at offer stage.
